integrity: Exact six-term rational inequality and independent ten-term alternating-series sign check; analytic proof of existence, simplicity and the convergence-radius obstruction. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Unique negative real zero only, not a classification of all complex zeros. The pole disproves the stated reciprocal-coefficient bound but does not disprove a sharper alternating-sum error term. An unindexed priority precedent remains possible.
title: A negative zero disproves the unitary-Euler reciprocal-coefficient conjecture
